verdict.rationale: The Innovator Founder visa page states "You must apply online," with separate in-UK and outside-UK flows. The processing-times page says applicants can submit documents and the application online via the UK Immigration: ID Check app, so the core apply transaction is completed online per UKVI's own pages. missing for 10: explicit first-party confirmation that the fee is paid online within the same flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end online completion.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: verify your identity and submit your documents and application online using the UK Immigration: ID Check app
